questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

Symbol @ % $ #
Mathematical Symbol + ×  ÷  -

The given expression is : 23 @ 105 $ 15 % 6 # 29

After inserting the mathematical symbols in given expression is as follows : 23 + 105 ÷ 15 × 6 - 29

= 23 + 7 × 6 - 29

= 23 + 42 - 29

= 65 - 29

= 36

Hence, the correct answer is "36".

questions.question: Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

Option 1) : − and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 - 18 ÷ 9 + 19 × 39 = 16

⇒ 72 - 18 ÷ 9 + 19 × 39 = 16

⇒ 72 - 2 + 19 × 39 = 16

⇒ 72 - 2 + 741 = 16

⇒ 813 - 2 = 16

⇒ 811 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : + and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 + 18 ÷ 9 × 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 + 18 ÷ 9 × 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 + 2 × 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 + 38 - 39 = 16

⇒ 110 - 39 = 16

⇒ 71 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : − and +

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ 72 × 18 ÷ 9 - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ 72 × 2 - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ 144 - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ 183 - 19 = 16

⇒ 164 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : ÷ and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 ÷ 18 × 9 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 ÷ 18 × 9 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 4 × 9 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 36 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 55 - 39 = 16

⇒ 16 = 16

LHS = RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "÷ and ×".

questions.questionHtml: If the signs ‘+’ and ‘÷ ' are interchanged, then which of the following equations can be correctly balanced?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

Option 1) : 22 + 11 × 8 ÷ 3 = 19 

After interchanging the symbols '+' and '÷' the equation is as follows : 22 ÷ 11 × 8 + 3 = 19

⇒ 22 ÷ 11 × 8 + 3 = 19

⇒ 2 × 8 + 3 = 19

⇒ 16 + 3 = 19

⇒ 19 = 19

LHS = RHS

Option 2) : 24 – 12 ÷ 6 + 3 = 20

After interchanging the symbols '+' and '÷' the equation is as follows : 24 - 12 + 6 ÷ 3 = 20

⇒ 24 - 12 + 6 ÷ 3 = 20

⇒ 24 - 12 + 2 = 20

⇒ 26 - 12 = 20

⇒ 14 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 12 + 4 – 8 ÷ 3 = 11 

After interchanging the symbols '+' and '÷' the equation is as follows : 12 ÷ 4 - 8 + 3 = 11

⇒ 12 ÷ 4 - 8 + 3 = 11

⇒ 3 - 8 + 3 = 11

⇒ 6 - 8 = 11

⇒ - 2 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : 16 + 4 × 8 ÷ 3 = 45 

After interchanging the symbols '+' and '÷' the equation is as follows : 16 ÷ 4 × 8 + 3 = 45

⇒ 16 ÷ 4 × 8 + 3 = 45

⇒ 4 × 8 + 3 = 45

questions.question: If '+' means '÷' ; '×' means '+' ; '÷' means '-' and '-' means '×'. Then what will be the value of the following expression? 18 + 3 - 5 × 6 ÷ 4
questions.questionHtml:
If '+' means '÷' ; '×' means '+' ; '÷' means '-' and '-' means '×'. Then what will be the value of the following expression?

18 + 3 - 5 × 6 ÷ 4
questions.solution:
The logic is :

Sign + × ÷ -
Denoted By ÷ + - ×
 

 

Given expression - 18 + 3 - 5 × 6 ÷ 4  

After interchanging the sign - 

= 18 ÷ 3 × 5 + 6 - 4    

= 6 × 5 + 6 - 4 

= 30 + 6 - 4

= 36 - 4

= 32

Hence, '32' is the correct answer.

Applying Bodmas rule, we will get,

9 - 24 × 4.4 + 4 = 630

13 - 105.6 = 630 

-92.6 ≠ 630

264 ÷ 4 × 9 + 60 – 24 = 630

66 × 9 + 60 – 24 = 630

594 + 60 – 24 = 630

654 – 24 = 630

630 = 630

LHS = RHS.

Option 4) 4 and 9, − and ×

264 + 24 - 4 ÷ 60 × 9 = 630

264 + 24 - 0.06 × 9 = 630

264 + 24 - 0.59 = 630

288 - 0.59 = 630

287.41 ≠ 630

LHS ≠ RHS.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

Sign ÷ +
Means + ÷

⇒ 30 ≠ 32

⇒ L.H.S ≠ R.H.S

This is not the correct equation.

Option 2: 12 – 8 + 12 × 9 ÷ 3 = 10

⇒ 12 – 8 ÷ 12 × 9 + 3 = 10

⇒ 12 - 6 + 3 = 10

⇒ 15 - 6 = 10

⇒ 9 ≠ 10

⇒ L.H.S ≠ R.H.S

This is not the correct equation.

Option 3:12 ÷ 8 × 3 + 6 – 10 = 8

⇒ 12 + 8 × 3 ÷ 6– 10 = 8

⇒ 12 + 8 × 0.5 – 10 = 8

⇒ 12 + 4 - 10 = 8

⇒ 16 - 10 = 8

⇒ 6 ≠ 8

⇒ L.H.S ≠ R.H.S

This is not the correct equation.

Option 4: 7 + 21 × 42 ÷ 14 – 9 = 19

After interchanging: 7 ÷ 21 × 42 + 14 – 9 = 19

⇒ 7 ÷ 21 × 42 + 14 – 9 = 19

⇒ 14 + 14 - 9  = 19

⇒ 28 - 9 = 19

⇒ 19 = 19

⇒ L.H.S = R.H.S

This is the correct equation.
